- Broader Node suite: **39 passed, 6 failed**, exactly matching untouched-base missing-fixture failures.

| Scenario | Dynamic median wall | Fixed 3/3 | Tuned fixed 2/4 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|

| Zero delay | 1.1662 s | 1.1050 s | 1.2224 s |

Earlier native tests twice rejected a nonoptimal solver score before dispatch; those failure logs are retained. The final 30-run sample had no such rejection.
